Main ek ladki ko bahut pyaar karta tha. Sach kahun toh, maine use dil se chaha tha, aur woh bhi mujhe bahut pyaar karti thi. Hum dono ne apne future ke baare mein socha tha, ek-dusre par poora bharosa kiya tha. Us waqt hum dono ko bilkul bhi nahi pata tha ki hamare beech aisa koi rishtedari ka connection hai.

Lekin baad mein achanak mujhe pata chala ki uski maa mere papa ki cousin sister hain. 🥹💔 Woh pal mere liye bahut mushkil tha. Jise main apni zindagi ka sabse khaas insaan samajhta tha, baad mein pata chala ki woh mere apne parivaar ka hi hissa hai.

Sach kahun toh yeh baat jaan kar mera dil bilkul toot gaya. Kyunki mera pyaar jhootha nahi tha, meri feelings bhi jhoothi nahi thi. Hum dono ne ek-dusre ko sach mein chaha tha, lekin hum is rishte ke baare mein jaante hi nahi the. Agar humein pehle se pata hota, shayad hamari kahani kabhi shuru hi nahi hoti.

Ab mujhe samajh aa gaya hai ki zindagi mein kabhi-kabhi jis insaan ko hum apna banana chahte hain, usse bhi door jaana padta hai. Kyunki kuch rishte pyaar se bhi upar hote hain—woh hain parivaar, apnapan aur izzat. ❤️

Main usse koi blame nahi karta, kyunki use bhi pehle is baat ka pata nahi tha. Main khud ko bhi blame nahi karta, kyunki mere dil mein kabhi koi galat iraada nahi tha. Hum dono ne bas ek-dusre ko pyaar kiya tha. Lekin ab jab sach saamne aa gaya hai, toh mujhe is sach ko accept karna hoga.

Woh mere liye hamesha ek achhi insaan rahegi. Shayad ab main usse pehle ki tarah baat nahi kar paunga, pehle ki tarah kareeb nahi aa paunga, lekin uske liye mere dil mein izzat hamesha rahegi. Ab se main use apni behen ki tarah pyaar aur respect dena chahta hoon. 🥹❤️

Zindagi mein kuch log hamare saath rehne ke liye nahi aate, balki humein kuch sikhane ke liye aate hain. Woh bhi meri zindagi ka ek bahut khaas chapter rahegi. Shayad hamari kahani ka end waisa nahi hua jaisa humne socha tha, lekin main nahi chahta ki hamara rishta nafrat ya misunderstanding ke saath khatam ho.

Main dil se dua karta hoon ki woh hamesha khush rahe, achhi rahe aur apni zindagi mein bahut aage badhe. ❤️

Kabhi-kabhi uski yaad aayegi, dil mein dard bhi hoga, aankhon mein aansu bhi aa jayenge. 🥹 Lekin main khud ko samjhaunga ki sachcha pyaar sirf kisi ko apna bana lene ka naam nahi hai. Kabhi-kabhi jise hum sach mein pyaar karte hain, uski khushi aur behtari ke liye khud hi peeche hat jaana bhi sachcha pyaar hota hai.

Hamare beech jo pyaar tha, main uski kabhi beizzati nahi karunga. Bas ab us pyaar ka naam badal jayega—pyaar se bhai-behen ke pavitra rishte mein. ❤️🥹

Zindagi ne humein jo raasta dikhaya hai, ab main usi raaste par aage badhunga. Shayad aaj bahut dard ho raha hai, lekin ek din yahi dard sirf ek khoobsurat yaad bankar reh jayega.

Main bas itni dua karta hoon ki woh hamesha khush rahe, muskurati rahe aur apni zindagi mein bahut success paaye. 🤲❤️

Kuch rishte kismat shuru karti hai, lekin parivaar ki sachchai un rishte ka matlab badal deti hai. Hamare saath bhi shayad kuch aisa hi hua. 🥹💔

Main use khona nahi chahta, lekin use ek galat rishte mein bhi nahi rakhna chahta. Isliye ab se woh mere liye ek apni insaan hai—meri behen. ❤️

Pyaar tha, hai aur hamesha dil mein ek izzat ke roop mein rahega. Lekin ab us pyaar mein koi umeed nahi hogi; sirf apnapan, respect aur uske khush rehne ki dua hogi. 🥹❤️

Kabhi meri zindagi mein uska naam yaad aayega toh dard ke saath ek muskurahat bhi hogi, kyunki woh meri zindagi ka woh hissa thi jise main kabhi galat nahi keh sakta. Bas waqt ne humein ek aisa sach dikha diya jiske baad pyaar ko ek naya rishta dena hi sahi tha.

Main uske liye hamesha dua karunga—
“Allah use hamesha khush rakhe, uski har khwahish poori kare aur uski zindagi ko khushiyon se bhar de.” 🤲❤️

Kabhi-kabhi kisi ko paana hi mohabbat nahi hota,
